# nemau_security_group (Resource)

A security group. Rules are separate resources (`nemau_security_group_rule`), as they are in the API. A group created now starts with two egress rules that allow all outbound traffic (`0.0.0.0/0` and `::/0`); they are not managed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_security_group" "web" {
  name        = "web"
  description = "HTTPS from anywhere"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Security group name. Changes in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description. Changes in place.
- `egress_filtering` (Boolean) Whether the group's egress rules are enforced. Always `true` for a group created now. `false` for a group created before egress filtering existed: all outbound traffic is allowed and its egress rules have no effect. Setting it from `false` to `true` converts the group in place: two allow-all egress rules are added, so traffic is unchanged until they are removed or narrowed. The conversion is one-way: `true` to `false` is refused at plan time.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Security group id.

## Import

```shell
# A security group imports by its id.
terraform import nemau_security_group.web 9b5d3e1f-2a7c-4f68-9d41-6e8a0c3b7f25
```
